headline: Astara district features coastal nature and low infrastructure coverage

tags.reason: The nature index is 79, backed by 60.1% forest cover and coastal location.
Heyət evi prices average 634 AZN/m², compared to national median of 575 AZN/m².

summary: Astara has a population of 113,600 across 617.2 km² with a population density of 183 people per km². The area features a nature index of 79 and a forest cover of 60.1%. Paved roads account for 17.1% of known surfaces, while the infrastructure index stands at 78. OSM coverage is medium, indicating that some objects are not mapped.
